correctness.rationale: The inward-drift last-zero comparison yields an exact pathwise range/error bound for every continuous Brownian forcing path. Conditional iid maxima have sqrt(4Dt log N) scaling; independent Exp(r) clock-age mixing yields CDF 1-exp(-z^2). The alternative logarithmic power vanishes by strict exponent inequality. Full hypotheses and boundary z<=0 covered; 430080 numerical inequalities are supplemental sanity checks only.
